message.reasoning:
We need to decide action. Observation: last round contributions: Resident5 60.75, Resident6 140.75 >30 both. Rule: If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in most recent round, punish that resident with max severity affordable. We have two such residents. Probably punish one? Rule says "punish that resident" singular; we can pick any. Choose max severity = floor(wallet/punishment_cost) = floor(50.62/0.3)= floor(168.733)=168 severity. Must target a resident with >30 contribution. Choose Resident6 (largest). Amount severity 168. Cost = severity * punishment_cost = 168*0.3 = 50.4 which is <= wallet 50.62, so affordable.

We also can broadcast message discouraging large contributions.

Thus one physical action punish, one broadcast.
